# 3ventz

3ventz is a public yearly calendar for hacker, maker, retro-computing, LAN, coding, music, demo-scene and related technology events, with a focus on Switzerland and nearby communities.

Canonical site: https://3ventz.ch/
Event sitemap: https://3ventz.ch/sitemap.xml

Individual events have crawlable detail pages under /event/ and may link to the organizer's official website. Event dates, categories, locations and descriptions come from the same database as the public yearly calendar.
